# Kapaat — Community Launch Checklist

## awesome-selfhosted Submission

Submit a PR to [awesome-selfhosted/awesome-selfhosted](https://github.com/awesome-selfhosted/awesome-selfhosted)
adding the following line under the **Inventory Management** section (alphabetical by name):

```markdown
- [Kapaat](https://github.com/nomi25home/kapaat) - Home storage inventory organised by room, zone and bin, with printable QR labels, an installable phone app with camera scanning, check-in/check-out, and optional Google Sheets sync. ([Demo](https://bins.home.mihirfamily.com), [Source Code](https://github.com/nomi25home/kapaat)) `MIT` `Python/Docker`
```

Check the demo link still works before submitting; remove the `([Demo](…), ` part if there is no public demo.

### Pre-submission checklist
- [x] Public GitHub repo with OSI-approved license (MIT)
- [ ] Working demo URL or screenshots in README (README has no screenshots yet)
- [x] Docker images published to GHCR (`ghcr.io/nomi25home/kapaat-api`, `ghcr.io/nomi25home/kapaat-web`, amd64 + arm64)
- [x] README covers install, config, and a quick-start
- [x] No sign-up required to self-host
- [ ] PR title format: `Add Kapaat`
- [ ] Entry placed alphabetically within the section
